(rule! (lambda (grid)
  ;; Position of the first red(2) cell
  (let* ((red-seed (first (find-color grid 2)))
         ;; Position of the first green(3) cell
         (blue-seed (first (find-color grid 3))))
    (define (walkable? row col value)
      (or (= value 2) (= value 3) (= value 5)))
    (define component
      (connected-region grid (fst red-seed) (snd red-seed) walkable? 4))
    (define reaches-blue
      (find (lambda (position)
              (and (= (first position) (fst blue-seed))
                   (= (second position) (snd blue-seed))))
            component))
    (if reaches-blue
        (recolor-cells grid
          (filter (lambda (position)
                    (= (cell-at grid (first position) (second position)) 5))
                  component)
          4)
        grid))))
